description: A dark, low-lit tomb chamber with mud-brick walls and wooden roof beams. In the foreground an open wooden plank coffin holds a skeleton wearing a gold helmet-like headdress, a turquoise and gold beaded necklace and round gold ear ornaments, with more beads scattered on the floor. A torch on the right casts a shaft of light. Pottery vessels and woven baskets sit on the earthen floor. No text is visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.
